label: SYNTHETIC: 10 invented patients and 60 conversation cases written by an AI assistant for the AI-simulated blind comparison of the local and cloud dialogue models (DT-250). None of the patients or sentences was used while the prompts were developed (those used the 12 approved cases in content/case_files and the staff set tests/dialogue_staff). Not human-written, not human-rated.
